tooltip.wearable_toolbox.equip: Can be equipped in the chest armor or body curio slot
wearable_toolbox.configuration.手臂前伸.tool: Whether the local player raises both arms while a wearable toolbox screen is open.
wearable_toolbox.configuration.低头.toolti: Whether the local player looks down while a wearable toolbox screen is open.
wearable_toolbox.configuration.物品栏内工具箱快捷: Whether toolboxes in the inventory can also be opened with the shortcut. If several are available, a selection screen opens first.
wearable_toolbox.configuration.工具箱优先级.to: Equal: wearable and nearby placed toolboxes appear in the toolbox selection first; Wearable: only the worn toolbox opens; Placed: nearby placed toolboxes take priority.
